headline: Copper Falls 3.14 Percent to $6.34 as Industrial Metals Give Up the Bid
narrative: Copper fell 3.14 percent to $6.34, money leaving the industrial-metals pipe. Oil fell 1.51 percent to $95, and the energy pipe sold with copper. The S&P 500 rose 0.36 percent to 7,568.92, money in the equity pipe while industrial metals sold.
author: jordan
